coverage_T: Malta [entire ADM0]; Italy (Molise [entire ADM1], Puglia [entire ADM1], Basilicata [entire ADM1], Calabria [entire ADM1], Sicily [entire ADM1], Sardinia [entire ADM1])

notes: Sea links: Calabria–Sicily (Strait of Messina), Malta–Sicily (Pozzallo/Valletta ferries), Sardinia via established ferries (Cagliari–Palermo/Naples). Sardinia kept here for population balance (adding it to 413 would leave this seat below band).

coverage_T: Portugal [entire ADM0]; Spain (Galicia [entire ADM1], Asturias [entire ADM1], Cantabria [entire ADM1], Castile and León [entire ADM1], Basque Country [entire ADM1], Extremadura [entire ADM1])
changes_vs_old: Spanish part enlarged from Galicia alone to Galicia + Asturias, Cantabria, Basque Country, Castile and León, Extremadura (old pop of 19.4m could not be met by Portugal + Galicia = ~13m).

Portugal borders Galicia, Castile and León, Extremadura; Asturias/Cantabria/Basque Country contiguous via the northern coast. Near upper band edge; Spain total scaled to WPP (47.85m), which is below INE counts.

notes: Pairing Catalonia with Madrid is driven by arithmetic (3 Iberian seats); all communities contiguous by land. Andorra borders Catalonia and France only.
